faqs.question: Are there any govt. job opportunities that I can seek after completing BSc course from Sanjay Ghodawat University?
faqs.answer: Today, a government job is preferable to a private job. Government job aspirants generally take BSc courses to achieve success in their respective fields. Upon completion of the BSc course from Sanjay Godawat University, candidates can seek different government job options in various fields. Following are some popular choices: - Civil Service, State Civil Service, Banking Sector, SSC Exam, Railways, Teaching Jobs, Defense Service, Public Service Undertaking, Translators, Interpreters, etc.

college_info.intro:
Sanjay Ghodawat University Kolhapur has a total of 10 schools of study, including Mgmt, Eng, Design, Media, Social Science, & others. The university has a wide range of courses at the UG & PG levels across diff. streams. MBA, BBA, & BTech are among the most popular programmes available at the university.
Sanjay Ghodawat University offers a full-time, four-year BTech programme at the UG level. The BTech programmes offered at the university cover core courses in the areas of Aeronautical Eng, Civil Eng, Electronics & Communication Eng, Computer Science & Eng, & AI & ML.
The MBA programme offered by the SGU Kolhapur is a 2-year course. It is offered in specialisations, including IB, Financial, HR, Marketing, & Operation & Supply Chain. Below are the Sanjay Ghodawat University's popular programmes:

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: The college has great learning environment with supportive faculty.

review_content.Placements: A good percentage is required, but a student with good skills is more important in my opinion. The highest package is 8 LPA, and the lowest is 3 LPA. Students having good knowledge of problem-solving can pass the interviews. There are many roles offered, but it's up to us what we prefer.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is too good and beautiful. The hostel is clean and great. Infrastructure consists of a lake, trees, gardens, statues, and much more. There is free Wi-Fi, clean labs, and larger classrooms. The library consists of different types of books. It has been a great experience.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Inside Sanjay Ghodawat University - SGU.

review_content.Placements: The percentage of students who get placed in our course is about 25%. The highest package offered is 6 LPA. The average package is 2 LPA. The lowest package offered is 1.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Cipla, Sun Pharma, Dr. Reddy's Laboratories, Lupin, etc. About 20% of students get internships from our course in Reddy's Laboratories and Lupin. Top role offered is junior pharmacist.
review_content.Infrastructure: Good facilities are available for our course and world-class infrastructure is built. The campus is very attractive and clean. Wi-Fi is available on the campus for free. Laboratories are well-equipped. Big classrooms are available. There is a big library also present. In the hostel, there are 4 students in one room and two fans are available in each room. Hostel mess food quality is not so good compared to the price they charge for one month which is Rs 3,500 for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Medical facilities are available on campus. Sports ground is so big and lots of games and competitions are held.

overview_faqs.question: Does Sanjay Ghodawat University refund fees?
overview_faqs.answer: After receiving duly signed admission cancellation request letter from the candidate as per schedule published by the Sanjay Ghodawat University, the University shall cancel the admission immediately. The refund of fees on or before cut-off date of admission declared by the Sanjay Ghodawat University, shall be made within two days i.e. total fee minus the processing charges of Rs.1,000/-, or refund rule shall be as per the guidelines of the appropriate authorities or the State Government, as the case may be. admission_overview.college_name: Sanjay Ghodawat University Admission 2025: Application Process, Eligibility, Courses & Fee

paragraphs: Sanjay Ghodawat University (SGU) offers more than 60 undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programmes in Technology, Architecture, Commerce & Management, Science, Computer Science & Applications, Liberal Arts, and Pharmaceutical Sciences. SGU accepts the applications in the online mode. Admission to various courses at the university is merit-based or entrance exam-based.

Apart from these courses, the university also provides financial support to students basis their academic merit and entrance exam scores. Also, SGU provides several job opportunities to students across various courses through campus placement drives where recruiters like Amazon, ICICI Bank, Infosys, and Wipro participate.

Merit in the last qualifying examination is the basic eligibility for various undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programmes offered at Sanjay Ghodawat University. However, admission to these courses is based on the scores obtained by the candidates in national, state, or university-level entrance exams. The table below lists various courses offered at SGU along with their application status, eligibility, and fee details:
Class 12 with 45% aggregate
JEE/ MHTCET/PERA CET
Class 12 with PCM/ Diploma
NATA/ JEE Main Paper II
Bachelor's degree with 50% aggregate

NEET/MHTCET
BE/ BTech with 45% aggregate
GATE/ PERA CET
BCA or equivalent degree with 50% aggregate
MAH-MCA-CET
Bachelor's degree from a recognised university
Master's degree

The admission procedure for Sanjay Ghodawat University involves multiple steps, such as appearing for the accepted entrance exam, application, selection, counselling, and admission confirmation. Students seeking admission must fulfil all of the required admission criteria before applying. Candidates have to qualify for all the rounds of the selection process. Find below the detailedSanjay Ghodawat University admissions process:
Step 1: Sanjay Ghodawat University Application Process 2025

Sanjay Ghodawat University's admission processstarts with the application process. Candidates can download the application process from the university's official website. The duly filled application form has to be sent either through post or submitted in person at the concerned department at Sanjay Ghodawat University. However, the application and entrance test fee will be paid online and candidates have to attach the pay slip along with the two copies of the online bank challan with the application form.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

Admission to all the UG and PG courses at Sanjay Ghodawat University is entrance-based. Candidates have to qualify for either university-level or state-level entrance exams such as SGUPET for the selection of respective courses.
Step 3: Merit List Release & Counselling

After the completion of all the selection rounds, candidates have to appear for the counselling process for the respective courses. Later on, the university will release the merit list in various rounds of the selected candidates. Students who find their names on the merit list need to pay a certain amount of fee to secure their seats.

faqs.question: Does Sanjay Ghodawat University refund fees?
faqs.answer: After receiving duly signed admission cancellation request letter from the candidate as per schedule published by the Sanjay Ghodawat University, the University shall cancel the admission immediately. The refund of fees on or before cut-off date of admission declared by the Sanjay Ghodawat University, shall be made within two days i.e. total fee minus the processing charges of Rs.1,000/-, or refund rule shall be as per the guidelines of the appropriate authorities or the State Government, as the case may be. If the admission is cancelled after the cut-off date of the admission declared by the Sanjay Ghodawat University, there shall be no refund except the Security Deposit and Caution Money Deposit. faqs.question: Does SGU offer better placements than KIT's IMER?
faqs.answer: Yes, SGU offer better placements than KIT's IMER. Placement rates at SGU are reportedly above 90% for a several of programmes, including the MBA and B.Tech. Depending on the programme and area of expertise, the average package ranges from INR 3.10 LPA to 5.50 LPA. Their success is attributed to their strong industry connections and specialised placement cell. Over 80% of students who applied to KIT's IMER were placed. A package typically costs between INR 3 and 4 LPA. In general, KIT's IMER fees are less than those at SGU.The market demand may favour some specialisations within a programme over others in terms of placement opportunities. It is advisable to compare information from the most recent reports for both universities, as placement data can vary from year to year.

faqs.question: Does Sanjay Ghodawat University have good placements?
faqs.answer: Yes, Sanjay Ghodawat University has a good placement history. Around 85% of students got placed at reputable companies like Tata Motors, L&T, and TCS. The university gave its students an average annual package of Rs 3.25 lakh in 2022; the lowest package was Rs 2.5 lakh. In the same year, MBA candidates received offers of a median package worth INR 3.80 lakh annually on average. In contrast to the previous year, there was a slight decrease in the number of students placed in 2023—roughly 35% fewer students were chosen. Furthermore, there were around 8% fewer organizations visiting for placements.

college_info.intro:
Sri Krishna College of Engineering and Technology comprises several departments, including the Department of Computer Science and Engineering, the Department of Electrical Engineering, and the Department of Engineering Design, among others. Through its departments, SKCET Coimbatore offers various UG, PG, and PhD courses.
The BTech and MTech programmes offered at the Sri Krishna College of Engineering and Technology are very popular among the students. The institute offers a four-year BTech programme and a two-year MTech programme in numerous specialisations. The popularity of these programmes is attributed to their curriculum, which has been developed and upgraded to enhance the knowledge of students in various branches of Engineering and Technology. SKCET Coimbatore aims at the holistic development of students and helps them to develop technical competencies as well as various soft skills required to target core-industry roles. The industry-institute relations established by SKCET Coimbatore provide students with the opportunity to undergo various training programmes organised by industry partners. SKCET Coimbatore also offers placement assistance to students and helps them get placed in top companies. The notable SKCET Coimbatore recruiters include Microsoft, Google, Accenture, Amazon, Infosys, Bosch, Capgemini, and HCL, among others. Sri Krishna College of Engineering and Technology offersBE,BTechat the UG level, andME,MBA,MTech (Integrated)course at PG level. In addition to that, the institute also offersPhDprogramme in the streams of Engineering.

For BTech admission, candidates must have atleast 45% aggregate in Class 12 and appear forTNEA exam,while for MTech, admission is done on the basis ofGATE/ CEETA score. Interested can apply online on the official website ofSKCET Coimbatore.

SKCET Coimbatore offers a total of 21 courses across various programme levels such as UG, PG, and Doctoral.SKCET Coimbatore coursesare offered in the regular/full-time mode for the shortlisted candidates. SKCET admission is open for admission 2025 now. Before applying, candidates must check they are meeting the eligibility criteria for their desired course. Sri Krishna College of Engineering and Technology admission process is conducted online.
Below are the step by step process forBTech admission at Sri Krishna College of Engineering and Technology:
Step 1: SKCET Application Process 2025
Candidates can find the online application form on the official website of the college. The application fee for general candidates is INR 500 and for reserved category candidates is INR 250.
Step 2: Document Verification

After completing the application process, candidates will be allotted a 10 digit random number which is required to report atTNEA facilitationcentres for document verification. Candidates must carry their original documents and photocopies during the document verification process.
Step 3: Merit-list

DOTE (conducting authority of TNEA) will prepare the merit list on the basis of the aggregate percentage secured in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics. Candidates after appearing for the required entrance test must check the shortlist that is created by the college.
Step 4: Counselling/ Payment of Admission Fee
Candidates who are in the merit list, will be able to attend theTNEA Counsellingas per the merit. Candidates are also required to pay the fee ofINR5000(INR 1000 for SC/ST) for SKCET admission.
Step 5: SKCET Seat Allotment for BTech

DOTE will release the result of the first round - seat allotment after the choice filling round. The seats allotment will be done on the basis of the merit list prepared by DOTE, course choices, and candidates' categories.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure at SKCET.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure was excellent. The classrooms were modern and had smart boards. The library was one of the largest and had a vast collection of books. This made it easy to find resources for project work or research. The canteen offered good food with decent options.

reviews.review_heading: Awesome placements, if you have skillsets then you can definitely get your dream offer.

Separate hostels for girls and boys are available. The mess provides decent-quality food, and the café and canteen offer good food items. An emergency medical team is present in the college. Sports and games events are organized regularly.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with this college. The faculty is helpful. It is value for money.

review_summary.college_name: PJTSAU Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Agriculture - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The college needs major improvement in all aspects.

content.Placements: Honesty, placements in PJTSAU are very disappointing for B.Sc. Agriculture students. Hardly 10-15% of students get placed, and the packages are very low compared to the effort and years of study. The highest package is not even attractive, the average is poor, and many students are left without any opportunity. Internships are also limited and not provided by reputed companies, so most students have to arrange them on their own. Top roles are not clear, mostly sales-related jobs which don't match our core field. Overall, the placement and internship support is extremely weak and does not meet expectations.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Agriculture - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good learning experience with decent campus life but average placements.

content.Placements: Honesty, around 25% of our batch got placed. Packages go up to 4.7 LPA, average is 3 LPA to 4 LPA. Companies like Coromandel, Syngenta, Bayer, and Godrej hire here. Many of us do internships in these firms too. Most roles are sales, field, or project-related. I will recommend it to my juniors.
content.Infrastructure: Our department has good classrooms, labs, and a decent library, plus campus Wi-Fi that works fine most of the time. Hostel rooms are okay, not very fancy but manageable. Mess food is average, some days good, some days boring. Canteen snacks are better. Medical help is available on campus, though for big issues, we go outside. Sports grounds and games are nice. You will always find friends playing in the evening that's one of the best parts.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Agriculture - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The wonderful PJTSAU at a glance.

content.Placements: The percentage of students placed in our course is based on EAMCET or AGRICET ranks. The package after this course is between 5 LPA to 10 LPA. Many seed companies recruit students after completing this course. Roles offered include AFO, Professor, SSC officer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: There is a huge academic section with department-wise. There are 10 departments on our campus. Near the academic section, there is a canteen and a ground to play on after finishing our classes. There is a well-facilitated hostel with more security for girls.

individual_reviews.course: MBA in Agri business Management - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Comprehensive review of Agribusiness Management at PJTSAU.

content.Placements: At PJTSAU, 40 percentage of the students will get placed, and the average package is about 5 Lacs per annum. Companies like Input Industries, Godrej Agrovet, Bayer, Syngenta, Cropwings, Khethari Agritech, Kapil Agro Farms, etc. Roles offered are analyst and etc.
content.Infrastructure: At PJTSAU, infrastructure facilities are quite excellent. Wi-Fi is available everywhere around the campus, laboratory and library facilities are well-equipped, and hostel facilities are available for both boys and girls. There is a large sports complex with encompassing facilities, along with a gym and indoor stadium.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Agriculture - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Review of Professor Jayashankar Telangana State Agricultural University.

content.Placements: Around 70% of students are getting placed in several companies every year. The highest salary package offered is 10 LPA. The average salary package offered is 5 LPA and the lowest salary package offered is 3 LPA for many students. Syngenta, Marut Drones, and Coromandel are some of the companies. No internship, but a few may get one in Aghub. Roles offered by this course include AEO, AFO, AO, IBPS, etc.
content.Infrastructure: We have an academic block with a digital smart board and speakers with a high-speed internet connection. A central library is open to every student. Food is good, and canteen is below the academic block. PHC is available for medical assistance. Sports meets are conducted between colleges.

The admission process includes the application process, selection round, cutoff, merit list or counselling, and other steps.PJTSAU admissions begin with the opening of registration portal. Below are the steps to get a seat in PJTSAU:
STEP 1: PJTSAU Application Process 2025

Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria can apply online for the preferred course. Aspirants need to pay an application fee of INR 1800 (INR 900 for SC/ ST/ PH) for BTech and BSc courses under MPC stream. The application fee for PG courses is INR 2,000 (INR 1,000 for SC/ ST/ PwD).
STEP 2: Selection

PJTSAU considers TS EMACET scores for admission to UG courses. Candidates with CUET-UG ranks can also apply for any of the UG programmes. The selection for PG programmes is based on ICAR AIEEA PG. Selected candidates may further be called for a GDPI round for MBA programme. Aspirants scoring equal or abovePJTSAU cutoffare called for counselling.
STEP 3: Counselling and Admission Confirmation

faqs.answer: PJTSAU considers national or state-level entrance exams for admission. The university accepts TG EAPCET or ICAR CUET for admission to BSc and BTech programmes. For MTech, MBA and MSc courses, selection is based on ICAR AIEEA PG scores of the candidates.

faqs.question: Is admission open at PJTSAU?
faqs.answer: Professor Jayashankar Telangana State Agricultural University (PJTSAU) admissions are closed for most of the courses. The university opens the admission cycle with the opening of registration portal. Admission to all the courses of PJTSAU is based on entrance-exam scores.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission at Professor Jayashankar Telangana State Agricultural University?
faqs.answer: No, it is not possible to enter in the college without giving the entrance exam. Professor Jayashankar Telangana State Agricultural University BE/ BTech admissions are based on Andhra Pradesh EAMCET score. For UG courses, the candidates will be selected on the basis of their performance in the TS EAMCET, conducted annually by the Department of Higher Education of the Government of Telangana. Selection to PG & Ph.D.programs will be done on the basis of marks obtained in the entrance test conducted by ICAR on all India basis.

review_summary.college_name: HBTU Kanpur Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Chemical Technology (Oil Technology) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Oil Technology don't include mineral oils and gases in HBTU.

content.Placements: HBTU holds a 100 percent placement record in the oil branch, with many of the students receiving more than one offer. The highest placement this year is 14 LPA, with an average package of 8 LPA, and the lowest is 4 LPA. The top recruiting companies include Ruchi Soya (under Patanjali), ExxonMobil, Reliance, and others. Almost 30 percent of the students in the 3rd year got internships, and almost 20 percent from the 2nd year in 2025. Apart from this, students from the 3rd and 4th years also perform research in the field of oil. The roles of oil technologists are offered.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: College is very good and has a powerful alumni network.

content.Placements: As of 2025, 59 students were eligible out of which 56 got placed in my branch in mechanical engineering. Placement percentage is 107%. Top recruitment companies are Samsung Electronics and TCS which often pick students in bulk. Almost 70% of students got internships from the campus.
content.Infrastructure: As we know, the college is very old thus the infrastructure is also very old but it gives chills too. The hostel is in bad condition. The mess food is below average for the first-year students. Water quality is bad as of now. Wi-Fi is available, which gives 8 GB per student per day but it is very slow.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Average campus. Placements are excellent for technology & core branches, but average for CS and IT.

content.Placements: The placement for core and technology branches is excellent. No college of this rank can compete with it. This college is a savior for students with ranks below 60,000- 65,000. For CS/IT, the placement is average. If you are in the top 50%–60% of your class, you will get a minimum placement of 8–9 LPA, a maximum of 18 LPA or more, and the lowest around 3–6 LPA. Most students get jobs as the placement rate is above 90%.
content.Infrastructure: Currently, IT does not have its own department. First-year classes are held in the lecture hall complex. While second- and third-year classes are in the main building. Classroom infrastructure is average, with some air-conditioned rooms. Fourth-year classes are held in the Computer Science department, whose infrastructure is below average. A new extension for the CS department is being built, which will also accommodate IT students. Overall, the college infrastructure is average, similar to most state government universities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: My hbtu 3 years journey.

content.Placements: In my batch there are 80 students and almost all my senior classes have the same strength. Almost 90 percent students got placed and the package in my branch is around 11 LPA and the internship opportunities are very limited for CSE and Information Technology students.
content.Infrastructure: The boys hostel is not too satisfying in terms of cleaning and the infrastructure is also not too good but the greenery is good in the college. The campus is too big and the boys hostel provides very limited restriction so students can do many extracurricular activities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: The college is decent best.

content.Placements: The core jobs are not very high because, if you are someone wanting to work in the core field, that will be quite difficult, as the company pattern shows that they hire more students from M.Tech. But if you learn coding through the four years of B.Tech, then the chances for placements are quite high, as you would have the choice of going to the IT sector and other software jobs.
content.Infrastructure: HBTU has two campuses: East Campus and West Campus. The East Campus has two boys’ hostels for first-year students and a girls’ hostel for each year. The West Campus has hostels only for boys of 2nd, 3rd, and final year, Shatabdi Bhavan for cultural events, a cricket ground, a gymnasium, and other facilities. However, the condition of the hostel rooms is not of a very high standard. The hostels accommodate single, double, and three-seater rooms.

Applications of only the eligible candidates are acceptable. Moreover, applicants must hold the mark sheets and other documents during form filling and admission confirmation.

faqs.question: What are the courses offered by HBTU, Kanpur?
faqs.answer: Harcourt Butler Technical University provides 50+ courses across six streams at undergraduate, postgraduate and PhD levels. These courses are accredited by the National Board of Accreditation (NBA). The admissions to UG, PG, and PhD courses, namely MCA, MTech, MBA, BTech, PhD, and MSc are based on the entrance exam. All the courses at HBTU are offered under its five schools, namely the School of Engineering, School of Chemical Technology, School of Basic and Applied Sciences, School of Enterpreneurship and Management and School of Humanities and Social Sciences.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission at HBTU Kanpur?
faqs.answer: HBTU Kanpur offers admission to most of the programmes based on entrance exam scores of the candidates. The university accepts scores in NIMCET, CUET, CAT, GATE, CUET-PG, etc. for admission to specific programmes. Aspirants also need to pass the GDPI round for MBA admission. Hence, direct admission is usually not possible at HBTU Kanpur.

reviews.review_heading: Oil Technology don't include mineral oils and gases in HBTU.
reviews.review_text: The college is equipped with Wi-Fi, advanced labs, and a vast library that has books that are almost 100 years old to the latest journals, research papers, and e-books. For oil, there are 3 labs (one for UG, one for PG, and one for advanced research and Ph.D.). The lab has some of the most advanced equipment in the field of oil, and even samples from IIT come to HBTU for testing in the field of oil. The campus has an infirmary for any medical issues, where a doctor is available 7 days a week, an...

reviews.review_heading: College is very good and has a powerful alumni network.
reviews.review_text: As we know, the college is very old thus the infrastructure is also very old but it gives chills too. The hostel is in bad condition. The mess food is below average for the first-year students. Water quality is bad as of now. Wi-Fi is available, which gives 8 GB per student per day but it is very slow.

reviews.review_heading: Average campus. Placements are excellent for technology & core branches, but average for CS and IT.
reviews.review_text: Currently, IT does not have its own department. First-year classes are held in the lecture hall complex. While second- and third-year classes are in the main building. Classroom infrastructure is average, with some air-conditioned rooms. Fourth-year classes are held in the Computer Science department, whose infrastructure is below average. A new extension for the CS department is being built, which will also accommodate IT students. Overall, the college infrastructure is average, similar to most...

reviews.review_heading: My hbtu 3  years journey.
reviews.review_text: The boys hostel is not too satisfying in terms of cleaning and the infrastructure is also not too good but the greenery is good in the college. The campus is too big and the boys hostel provides very limited restriction so students can do many extracurricular activities.

reviews.review_heading: The college is decent best.
reviews.review_text: HBTU has two campuses: East Campus and West Campus. The East Campus has two boys’ hostels for first-year students and a girls’ hostel for each year. The West Campus has hostels only for boys of 2nd, 3rd, and final year, Shatabdi Bhavan for cultural events, a cricket ground, a gymnasium, and other facilities. However, the condition of the hostel rooms is not of a very high standard. The hostels accommodate single, double, and three-seater rooms.

reviews.review_heading: The underrated college with a great scope of improvement and decent placement.
reviews.review_text: The classes are spacious and well-ventilated with ACs. The library is huge, with over 1 lakh books. HBTU also has multiple canteens across the campus, offering plenty of spots to explore and hang out, making the overall campus experience lively and enjoyable.

reviews.review_heading: College is good in academics and also in extracurricular activities.
reviews.review_text: Labs and classrooms are so good, while the campus is fine, and libraries are so good. About 1 lakh books are available in the college, which is a good facility in the hostel, and the seniors are very supportive in the college, so the academics are going smoothly.

reviews.review_heading: Good college like in placements, course, alumni network.
reviews.review_text: The campus life is not that much good as compared to other colleges, and the location of the college is also a negative side. Hostel life is good until unless you are in East campus (where all the academic and administrative buildings are present). According to me, it’s better to take private hostel than choosing West campus hostel like Ambedkar and Aryabhatt in 1st year.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely worthy to join this college as it has a nice network.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is good and present all over campus. Food is good, and we can decide the menu by talking to our mess secretary. We can also add or subtract food items from the menu if people agree with us. The canteen is average, as we get normal things like samosas and parathas.

reviews.review_heading: Chemical/CT at HBTU is worth it, strong academics and consistently solid placements.
reviews.review_text: The campus is decent but mostly old. Buildings are functional, not modern. Labs are mixed, some are updated, while some are outdated. The hostel is basic with average maintenance; rooms are simple, and the mess food is consistent. Overall, it is a workable environment, but don’t expect premium facilities.

reviews.review_heading: The best college in Uttar Pradesh after the IIT.
reviews.review_text: There are several facilities in the hostels. There are separate hostels for girls and boys, in which facilities of mess and very variety of food and cultural diversity are also seen. Many students in Kanpur are from Kanpur itself as it offers a very good rate of interest to students.

reviews.review_heading: Review of HBTU (one of the top state universities).
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of my department is quite old and needs renovation. Wi-Fi is available with good speed throughout the campus. If I talk about the library, it is well-maintained and you can get almost all books and journals from here. The quality of rooms in the hostel is average, and you'll get double and triply seated rooms in 1st,  2nd and 3rd year, while in the final year, you will get a personal single room for sure. The quality of the mess food is average, but it degrades as time passes.

reviews.review_heading: HBTU is a decent college with a long history and also good recognition in Uttar Pradesh.
reviews.review_text: Library in HBTU is very nice. Fully air-conditioned and have the best infrastructure. But the infrastructure of hostels on the East Campus is old. It needs yearly maintenance however, the West campus is a perfect example of good infrastructure. There are several auditoriums in college and multiple grounds for sports and physical activities.

reviews.review_heading: Choose this college if you are not getting good NITs and you are ready for the grind.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs and library are available, classrooms are average. Hostel is also average with all basic facilities, a mess, laundry, canteen, and basic equipments for sports. Infrastructure of both departmental and hostel building is average. Medical facilities are provided by a dispensary in college. Students also receive insurance cover from college supported by a company.

reviews.review_heading: Our infrastructure is improving day by day. Faculty members are really nice and help us.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure gets enhanced by our faculty members according to the requirements as new labs are designed for us to get into it deeper and understand the techniques used in biotechnology. We have a central library and classrooms with AC. Wi-Fi is provided all over the campus. My hostel is Vishwakarma, where facilities are really good. Canteen is also available for us. The quality of food is so good. On college campus medical facilities are also available.

reviews.review_heading: A general review of my college.
reviews.review_text: The college campus in general has a main building that has all the classrooms, a small canteen, a medium-sized canteen area behind the building, a small bamboo grove, basement parking, and two computer labs equipped with Mac and Windows systems. The college provides speedy Wi-Fi as well.

reviews.review_heading: COLLEGE REVIEW (lisaa school design).
reviews.review_text: The college has decent infrastructure, there is a canteen that provides food. Some Classrooms provide required facilities like laptops. There is no library which could be a sphere of improvement. Facilities for foundation year is provided like art supplies etc.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has good teachers, placements, and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The college doesn't have a so-called campus vibe. It is a building situated in Koramangala. We get access to Wi-Fi for academic purposes. We have a decent classroom to occupy a maximum of 20 students. There is a hall on the top floor where combined classes and events take place. Labs and a library are also available. There is no hostel facility provided by the college, but the college coordinators help students find the best PGs nearby. We have an integration day happening every year where we ha...

reviews.review_heading: Our college has great courses and great faculty members.
reviews.review_text: It has big classrooms. Each classroom can accommodate around 20 students. Wi-Fi is available in classrooms. There is a library with design books you can refer to. The college also provides Mac labs. There is a projector in every classroom. The quality of food available at the canteen is also very good.

reviews.review_heading: Review of LISAA School of Design, Bangalore.
reviews.review_text: The campus is sophisticated, with colourfully painted walls. The canteen serves delicious and homey food. Classrooms have air conditioning and other necessary amenities. There are two computer labs and a reading room. The college is well maintained.

reviews.review_heading: Experience at Lisaa school of design, Bangalore was good.
reviews.review_text: I would suggest you have your own laptops without completely relying on the labs in college. Being an outsider you will find some difficulty to find a stay nearby since there is no hostel on the campus. Nevertheless the management will help you out by suggesting a good PG within walking distance.

reviews.review_heading: Lisaa is a good place to discover your designing skills and be industry ready.
reviews.review_text: There is good infrastructure, with mac lab, PC lab, sewing lab, library, workshops and plenty of classrooms. There are good classrooms for studio classes as well. I have not opted for hostel. I have heard that they have good tie-ups. There is a canteen with good food.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the course.
reviews.review_text: The facilities like Wi-Fi, labs and classrooms were provided but was not very consistent in terms of quality. It would appreciated if the college provided proper software in the labs and better Wi-Fi connection. Canteen facilities kept changing and was not consistent. Would recommend more sports activities for better productivity in academics.

reviews.review_heading: LISAA is the place to learn and enjoy.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good with all sorts of facilities such as canteen, Wi-Fi, advanced classrooms and labs. We have a mac lab too for which I feel really lucky to be a part of LISSA. Sadly there is no hostel yet, but we can find flats and PGs nearby.

reviews.review_heading: Lissa School of Design, Bangalore has one of the best infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text:
We were facilitated with high-speed wi-fi, Mac labs, Classrooms with projectors, cafeteria, Library. The quality of the food was decent enough in the canteen.
We used to go out for outdoor games like football and cricket.

reviews.review_heading: Its a good college with good name, but then management is a messed up else all is good.
reviews.review_text: 'A' grade infrastructure with Mac labs, studios for photography and shoots, a workshop for product and interior design, labs for fashion design. The canteen provides decent quality food, and it's mostly homemade food. Our college has recently moved to a new address, so the building is little messed up.

reviews.review_heading: Review of LISAA School of Design, Bangalore.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good. Our campus is fully air-conditioned. Classrooms have adequate benches and comfortable seats. Our campus is Wi-Fi enabled and the speed is very fast. The food served in the canteen is good.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college for designing students.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is excellent. Our campus is situated in a hilly area.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college for students who are interested in the design field around Bangalore city.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is not available at the college. There are a lot of PGs for boys and girls available within 1 km of campus, which are budget-friendly. A few of them are tied up with the college.

reviews.review_heading: Review of LISAA School of Design, Bangalore.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course are good. There are computer labs and good Wi-Fi. We are also provided with projectors in the classrooms. It helps teachers to teach us more conveniently. We don't have a hostel facility. Overall, everything is good.

reviews_list.review_title: The infrastructure and faculty are good. Overall, it is a good experience with everything.

review_content.Placements: About 73% of students get placed this year. The rest take up higher studies. The average package stands at around 9.5 LPA for students studying ECE (Electrical and Computer Engineering). The highest average is around 12 LPA for Computer majors and around 11 LPA for Business Management students.
review_content.Infrastructure: The classrooms are fully air-conditioned 24/7. The libraries are open for an adequate amount of time for everyone to access. Hostel rooms are good, but some issues are not fixed with immediate action. Network issues are found in some places, but overall, Wi-Fi has good coverage everywhere. Medical facilities are really bad, even for the slightest issues, we are asked to go to a specialty hospital outside. The sports infrastructure is good. Canteen food can be made better, and slight improvements are being seen now.

review_summary.college_name: SNU Noida Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: There is really good infrastructure and facilities at SNU.

content.Placements: The placement process is going on right now. Placements are average as the student count is low. Top recruiting companies for our course are HCL, Microsoft, Adobe, HPE, etc. The top role offered is SDE. 30-40 percent of students get internships from companies like Adobe and Microsoft. Other roles offered are data analyst.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities are top-notch, as compared to other colleges. The hostel experience is very good as hot water is provided. A pantry is also available. Wi-Fi is present all over the campus, which works excellently. The quality of food is excellent and is affordable. Apart from the mess, there are various other food stalls.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) Global - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: It has a very good campus and infrastructure.

content.Placements: There are 100% placements, but companies are not coming up with a good package. Very few known and big companies visit the college for placements. For internships, there are no good companies, as some are even fraudulent, and they state something and make us do fundraising or sales. Companies that visit the college are not good.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel rooms provided are very good. Especially MBA or master's students have personal rooms. There are AC rooms in all weather situations. The food is also good. There are both indoor and outdoor sports. For medical emergencies, there is a healthcare centre on campus. The campus also has its own incubation centre.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Computer Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The infrastructure and faculty are good. Overall, it is a good experience with everything.

content.Placements: About 73% of students get placed this year. The rest take up higher studies. The average package stands at around 9.5 LPA for students studying ECE (Electrical and Computer Engineering). The highest average is around 12 LPA for Computer majors and around 11 LPA for Business Management students.
content.Infrastructure: The classrooms are fully air-conditioned 24/7. The libraries are open for an adequate amount of time for everyone to access. Hostel rooms are good, but some issues are not fixed with immediate action. Network issues are found in some places, but overall, Wi-Fi has good coverage everywhere. Medical facilities are really bad, even for the slightest issues, we are asked to go to a specialty hospital outside. The sports infrastructure is good. Canteen food can be made better, and slight improvements are being seen now.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Computer Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: A solid foundation for engineering students with world class facilities.

content.Placements: 90% of students got placed from my course this year. The highest package is 45 LPA, the lowest is 7 LPA, and the average is 12 LPA. Top recruiting companies for my course are NVIDIA, Google, Microsoft, Qualcomm India, Samsung, etc. Most of the students about 85% got internships in companies like Wipro, HCL, Qualcomm India, Google, etc. The top roles that are offered are electrical engineer, software developer, design engineer, analog design engineer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The campus offers fully Wi-Fi and AC-equipped classrooms, advanced labs, and a well-stocked library. Hostel facilities are excellent with hygienic food in the mess. Medical care is available in the campus. Sports and games are well-supported with proper facilities and trained coaches.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Computer Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It is best to enjoy your college life in a friendly environment.

content.Placements: Most students from the passed-out batch are placed, mainly around 90 percent. The highest package is 28 LPA, the lowest package is 6 LPA, and the average package is around 10 or 11 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Intel, Nvidia, Samsung, HCL, and many more. About 70 percent of students got internships from my course in companies like Wipro, TCS, HCL, etc. The top roles offered include IoT Engineer, Research Intern, Software Engineer, and Data Analyst.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities provided for my course are top-class, with a fully Wi-Fi campus, labs for experiments, every classroom with AC, and a well-maintained library. Facilities provided in hostels are excellent, with both single and double-sharing rooms available. The food quality is also excellent, providing nutritious and healthy meals. Our college offers essential medical facilities to ensure the health and well-being of all students and staff, with a tie-up with HCL Healthcare. Our college actively promotes physical fitness through a wide range of sports.

reviews.review_heading: There is really good infrastructure and facilities at SNU.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are top-notch, as compared to other colleges. The hostel experience is very good as hot water is provided. A pantry is also available. Wi-Fi is present all over the campus, which works excellently. The quality of food is excellent and is affordable. Apart from the mess, there are various other food stalls.

reviews.review_heading: It has a very good campus and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The hostel rooms provided are very good. Especially MBA or master's students have personal rooms. There are AC rooms in all weather situations. The food is also good. There are both indoor and outdoor sports. For medical emergencies, there is a healthcare centre on campus. The campus also has its own incubation centre.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure and faculty are good. Overall, it is a good experience with everything.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms are fully air-conditioned 24/7. The libraries are open for an adequate amount of time for everyone to access. Hostel rooms are good, but some issues are not fixed with immediate action. Network issues are found in some places, but overall, Wi-Fi has good coverage everywhere. Medical facilities are really bad, even for the slightest issues, we are asked to go to a specialty hospital outside. The sports infrastructure is good. Canteen food can be made better, and slight improvements...

reviews.review_heading: A solid foundation for engineering students with world class facilities.
reviews.review_text: The campus offers fully Wi-Fi and AC-equipped classrooms, advanced labs, and a well-stocked library. Hostel facilities are excellent with hygienic food in the mess. Medical care is available in the campus. Sports and games are well-supported with proper facilities and trained coaches.

reviews.review_heading: It is best to enjoy your college life in a friendly environment.
reviews.review_text: Facilities provided for my course are top-class, with a fully Wi-Fi campus, labs for experiments, every classroom with AC, and a well-maintained library. Facilities provided in hostels are excellent, with both single and double-sharing rooms available. The food quality is also excellent, providing nutritious and healthy meals. Our college offers essential medical facilities to ensure the health and well-being of all students and staff, with a tie-up with HCL Healthcare. Our college actively prom...

reviews.review_heading: Overall, good packages and a decent college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is nice for the entire campus. But for hostels, it's the reverse. You don't get clean drinking water, so we have to purchase water bottles from our side. You also don't get hot water 24/7. Also, you are not allowed to bring a theater or any electronics.

reviews.review_heading: Great campus and good faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The mess food is good and the taste is also great. The food quality is maintained. There are breakfast, lunch, evening, dinner, and midnight meals offered to students. Hostels have twin and single sharing options and AC or non-AC options as well for students.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with good placements.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are fully AC, neat and clean, and also well-maintained. There is Wi-Fi all over the campus and the library has a 24/7 study room as well. The mess food has a variety of options and okayish quality of food. For sports, ISC is there which has all indoor sports facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Quality education, really good infrastructure, and good enough placements.
reviews.review_text: There is amazing infrastructure. 24/7 Wi-Fi is there. We have a proper library with an all-time accessible hall. Projectors are there in classes. Food quality is also good. There are various food options. The mess and other vendors are there. There is a mini hospital inside the campus. There is also a sports complex with a gym, pool table, basketball, and many more.

reviews.review_heading: Brutally honest review about SNU.
reviews.review_text: The department has well-equipped labs with great computers (serve too for research purposes) and 24X7 Wi-Fi throughout the campus. Hostels are decent. Hostel rooms are double occupancy and are spacious. The only issue is that the hot water doesn't come in the assigned period. Mess food is terrible. I mean other college students say our is better than their but still hostel food is just good enough to fill our belly. There are good medical facilities and sports facilities too.

reviews.review_heading: I absolutely love this college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is top-notch, with well-equipped labs and classrooms. You get every facility here. The food is managed by Sodexo, so there are no compromises in food and medical facilities. Hostels have a pantry and both squad and double-sharing rooms. Some floors have ACs, while others do not.

reviews.review_heading: Great infrastructure, good placements.
reviews.review_text: The hostels are well organized, neat, and clean. Proper hygiene is maintained in the preparation of mess food, and it is tasty with good options for students. There is a hospital inside the campus for all medical facilities for the students. The sports complex has all sports-related facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Good college overall, good placements.
reviews.review_text: Great infrastructure and best classrooms. The library and classrooms are fully air-conditioned and well maintained. The students' Wi-Fi is present around the entire campus. The labs for practicals are also great in terms of equipment. The food at the mess is also good in taste.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure and faculty are amazing.
reviews.review_text: Mess food is quite good, with a variety of meals from North and South India served daily. It is completely hygienic and is served by the catering partner Sodexo, which is a well-known company in this field. Infrastructure is good, with high-speed Wi-Fi, air conditioner, washing machines, and common rooms equipped with TV and table tennis. The registration process is also quite simple and is completed on the day of arrival. Hostel rooms are spacious, in good condition, and quite affordable.

reviews.review_heading: Hidden realities of SNU college
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very good. SNU is planning to increase the area further so that they can create more sports fields. Wi-Fi speed is 400mbps but only for the showcase, your mobile data will work faster than the Wi-Fi. Classrooms and auditoriums are well-equipped with projectors and ACs, but hostel rooms don't have AC. Even the water quality is not that good. Quality of food is acceptable, they provide 5 meals a day.

data.description: Shiv Nadar University offers various facilities to teaching and non-teaching staff members. Faculty and various staff residing on the campus have access to dining and several fitness facilities. The university has an experienced faculty. Some faculty are PhD holders while others are master's degree holders. Some faculty members are even pursuing their Doctorate from renowned organisations. Shiv Nadar University also conducts workshops and guest lectures so as to increase the knowledge and required skills of the students.

review_content.Placements: 90% plus students got placed. Average salary package is 18 LPA. The highest is 53 LPA. Apple, Google, Goldman Sachs recruit. review_content.Infrastructure: Good infrastructure. Non-AC classrooms. Laboratory buildings have AC and are open 24/7. Library is really good. Hostel is also good. review_content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, all types of labs, classrooms, a library and many facilities are on our campus, and these things are very good. Hostels are also good. You have a choice if you want to eat in a mess, you can, and canteens are always open. The mess has an average quality of food, while the canteen has good quality food. review_summary.college_name: Dhirubhai Ambani University (formerly DA-IICT) Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mathematics and Computing - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Strong academics and placements with a rigorous curriculum and good campus facilities.

content.Placements: High placement percentage, often above 90 percent. The highest package is 50–60 LPA for top performers. The median package is 10 LPA across all offers, indicating a broad range of salaries. Top recruiting companies are Amazon, Google, Apple, Goldman Sachs, Oracle, and LinkedIn. Many students indicate that around 15–20 percent of students secured internships at major companies like Microsoft, Amazon, and Google. Top job roles are software engineer/software developer, data scientist/data analyst, business analyst, technical analyst, and development engineer.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mathematics and Computing - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: College tour of DAIICT by a first semester guy.

content.Placements: The college placement seems to be going down with time, similar to the placement of CS engineering students as the college has almost all branches related to computer Science and programming. The companies visiting for internships are better than the ones visiting for actual placement. 35 percent of the batch is placed, top recruiting company is Unified Apps, and the top roles for MNC are Software Development Engineer.
content.Infrastructure: The mess is just compulsory for the first year as of now. The food at the mess is not that great, sports are good, though you have to bring your own equipment, and there are medical facilities available throughout the year. There is Wi-Fi for all students with a limit of 20 GB a day.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. (Hons.) in Information and Communication Technology with minor in Computational Science - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Good environment. Good college structure. Around 18 LPA is the average package.

content.Placements: 90% plus students got placed. Average salary package is 18 LPA. The highest is 53 LPA. Apple, Google, Goldman Sachs recruit. Around 20% students got internships in good companies. Unfiapp hired so many students this year. And so many companies are coming to campus. Students do competitive coding.
content.Infrastructure: Good infrastructure. Non-AC classrooms. Laboratory buildings have AC and are open 24/7. Library is really good. Hostel is also good. Two-sharing and three-sharing rooms are available. Eco-friendly campus. There are so many birds. But sometimes monkeys come into hostel.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and VLSI Design (EVD) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: I think our college is very good, especially for our course.

content.Placements: This is a new course, DAIICT, and the first batch will be passing in 2029, but other branches like ICT and Master's placements are good. I think the semiconductor industry is being established near Gandhinagar, so they want good engineers for so many companies, so placements will be very good.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, all types of labs, classrooms, a library and many facilities are on our campus, and these things are very good. Hostels are also good. There is a mess and a canteen for first-year students, the mess is compulsory after completion of the first year. You have a choice if you want to eat in a mess, you can, and canteens are always open. The mess has an average quality of food, while the canteen has good quality food. Medical facilities will be provided by the college, and they are good. It has a particular time for doctors. There's a huge sports complex.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information and Communication Technology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Where teach dreams meet top-tier placements.

content.Placements: This college maintains a placement rate of 90% for its B.Teach and M.Teach programs. Companies like Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Goldman Sachs, Oracle, etc. Frequently recruit from this college. The average package for B.Teach students ranges from Rs. 12-18 LPA while the highest package can go up to 50 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: This college has 50 acres of area in total with well-maintained lawns, a garden, and open space. Equipped with smart classrooms, seminar halls, and lecture theatres with modern audio-visual facilities. Boys and girls have different hostel blocks with decent living conditions.

hostel_campus.college_name: Dhirubhai Ambani University (formerly DA-IICT) Infrastructure Details & Reviews

hostel.description: Dhirubhai Ambani Institute of Information and Communication Technology has two halls of residence, one for men and the other for women. The rooms are furnished with a bed, table, chair and a cupboard for each occupant. For students using their own computers in the room, internet facility is provided at a very nominal per semester charge. Hot water (using solar panels), Laundry and TV Rooms with Dish TV are available in both halls of residence. Residence at the Halls is compulsory for all B.Tech. students.

library.description: The library of DAIICT connects the user to its relevant information resources. It has a rich and diverse collection of about 31020 books, 11230 e-books, 5674  e-journals, 78 print journals, 10 databases, 663 theses and 3913 audiovisual material in the ICT, social science, and humanities. This collection can be searched by a web-enabled online catalog. The students can also browse and access the various electronic resources such as e-journals, e-books, and databases using the dedicated terminals in the reading zones. The library has resource sharing a collaboration with Information and Library Network (INFLIBNET) and National Digital Library of India (NDLI).

sports.description: Available Facilities: Badminton Court, Basketball Court, Cricket Ground, Football Ground, Volleyball Court, Table Tennis

reviews.review_heading: Strong academics and placements with a rigorous curriculum and good campus facilities.
reviews.review_text: Campus overview includes classrooms and lecture spaces, library/resource centre, and laboratories. Facilities provide high-speed Wi-Fi/LAN in rooms. Hot water, laundry services, TV rooms, and basic utilities are available. Common washrooms are provided and are not usually attached. Security and maintenance services are available on campus. Sports facilities include cricket ground, volleyball, football, basketball, and badminton courts. A gym for fitness, yoga space, and music rooms are available...

reviews.review_heading: College tour of DAIICT by a first semester guy.
reviews.review_text: The mess is just compulsory for the first year as of now. The food at the mess is not that great, sports are good, though you have to bring your own equipment, and there are medical facilities available throughout the year. There is Wi-Fi for all students with a limit of 20 GB a day.

reviews.review_heading: Good environment. Good college structure. Around 18 LPA is the average package.
reviews.review_text: Good infrastructure. Non-AC classrooms. Laboratory buildings have AC and are open 24/7. Library is really good. Hostel is also good. Two-sharing and three-sharing rooms are available. Eco-friendly campus. There are so many birds. But sometimes monkeys come into hostel.

reviews.review_heading: I think our college is very good, especially for our course.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, all types of labs, classrooms, a library and many facilities are on our campus, and these things are very good. Hostels are also good. There is a mess and a canteen for first-year students, the mess is compulsory after completion of the first year. You have a choice if you want to eat in a mess, you can, and canteens are always open. The mess has an average quality of food, while the canteen has good quality food. Medical facilities will be provided by the college, and they are good. It h...

reviews.review_heading: Where teach dreams meet top-tier placements.
reviews.review_text: This college has 50 acres of area in total with well-maintained lawns, a garden, and open space. Equipped with smart classrooms, seminar halls, and lecture theatres with modern audio-visual facilities. Boys and girls have different hostel blocks with decent living conditions.

reviews.review_heading: It is a great place for good exposure. I have a great college experience.
reviews.review_text: It has good hostels. Labs and classrooms are well-equipped. The lecture theatre is good. A mess facility is available and mandatory for freshers. The canteen service is good. The annual sports fest is awesome.

reviews.review_heading: Engineering heaven of Gujarat.
reviews.review_text: Here, placements at DAIICT are very awesome. Although there is a lack of tech jobs. There are also 90% of placements. Companies are JP Morgan, Morgan Stanley, TCS, Reliance, and so on. If we want to go into such huge MNCs then of course take admission in DAIICT.

reviews.review_heading: Good enough to start here!
reviews.review_text: Hostel rooms, Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and the library are all good. Hostel rooms are non-AC, but Wi-Fi is really good. The canteen food is average, but around the college, there are lots of options to eat. Medical facilities are also good. The gym is not that great, and the game facilities are average.

reviews.review_heading: Really very good infrastructure and the placements are very good.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are excellent, like the best college in Gujarat. The hostels of DAIICT are amazing, and the ground is very big, giving a feel like we are in a real cricket ground. The medical facilities are also good; 2 or 3 doctors come from other hospitals.

reviews.review_heading: A state of the art infrastructure with average placement opportunity and a high fees.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for the ICT course is top-notch. There are state-of-the-art lab facilities and a library containing around 30,000 books with a reading room that is open until 12 am, and for exam days, the timing is until 2 am. All the professors are well qualified and experts in their field.

reviews.review_heading: Value for money college.
reviews.review_text: The college has a very wide campus. The infrastructure of our college is well developed. The college has all the facilities, including Wi-Fi, canteen, mess, hostel, labs, library, swimming pool, medical facility, sports facility, etc. The college computer labs are working properly. The college also focuses on sports activities. There are all sports facilities available in our college.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Dhirubhai Ambani Institute of Information and Communication Technology.
reviews.review_text: At DAIICT, the hostel has two types of rooms: double occupancy and triple occupancy rooms. In every room for each student, there is a bed, a cupboard, a table, and a chair. It provides Wi-Fi facilities to students. There are 5 canteens. You can choose from where you want to buy. Overall, the food quality is good. Doctors visit our campus twice a day.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is good in terms of placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college and the hostel is good. Our college provides us with all the facilities. They provide sufficient facilities. The mess facility is not available in our college. We have many food courts where we can get anything at any time.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has excellent placements and a good hostel.
reviews.review_text: The hostel life is good. Our college provides good infrastructure. Sports activities are done very often. Mess facilities are not available.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has a perfect coding culture and competition.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides 24X7 Wi-Fi. Classrooms are huge and comfortable. There is a resource center in our college where we can read after study hours. It also has a library in it. There are many labs. They are in good condition with all equipment. There are canteens for vegetarian and non-vegetarian food items. They provide a variety of food items. There are grounds for football, cricket, volleyball, badminton, basketball, table tennis, etc. Our college has a gymnasium. It is in perfect condition....

JD Institute of Fashion Technology, founded in 1988, is one of India's oldest and most prestigious art and design schools. In India, there are 38 campuses. Cumulus, the Indo-Italian Chamber of Commerce and Industry, the Indo-French Chamber of Commerce and Industry, the Council of EU Chambers of Business in India, and EQAC (Education quality accreditation Commission, Spain) are a few examples of which JD Institute of Fashion Technology is associated to Adobe, the Institute of Indian Interior Designers (IIID), and the Association of Designers of India (ADI) are all creative partners of JD Institute of Fashion Technology. 'UK Asian Business Award,' 'Best Vocational Education Institute of the Year-Fashion Design,' 'International Glory Award for the Best Design Institution,' 'Best Skill Learning for Fashion Design in India at the Indian Education Awards 2018,' and many more have been bestowed upon the institute.

The Institute provides a variety of courses in the fields of Fashion Design, Interior Design, Jewellery Design, Fashion Business Management and Visual Merchandising, among others, at the diploma, advance diploma, UG diploma levels and PG diploma levels. Each Diploma specialisation in Design and Fashion at JD Institute of Fashion Technology has a maximum intake of 25 students.

JD Institute of Fashion Technology provides a variety of programs including Fashion Design, Interior Design, Jewellery Design, Visual Merchandising, Fashion and Business Management among others. A few of the most popular courses, along with their eligibility requirements, are given below:

placements.overview:
JD Institute of Fashion Technology, Kamla Nagar - Corporate Extension Centre is a private institute. JD Institute of Fashion Technology, Kamla Nagar - Corporate Extension Centre offers a total of 31 courses at UG, PG and Certificate levels in 6 specialisations such as Apparel Design, Fashion Design, Jewellery Design, Makeup & Beautician and Textile Design. Furthermore, it offer courses such as B.Sc., B.Des, After 10th Diploma, PG Diploma and UG Diploma in Full Time mode. JD Institute of Fashion Technology, Kamla Nagar - Corporate Extension Centre fee structure includes a total tuition fee ranging from INR 28,780 to 9,31,000. JD Institute of Fashion Technology, Kamla Nagar - Corporate Extension Centre has an annual seat intake of 1005 for all the programmes. It offers courses, in streams such as Arts ( Fine / Visual / Performing ), Design, Humanities & Social Sciences and Beauty & Fitness. The institute has a safe and well-equipped campus with all the advanced facilities.

reviews_list.batch_info: Under Graduate Program in Fashion Design (Industrial Collaboration with Subharti University) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Satisfied with the campus environment and excellent faculty.

review_content.Placements: The average package offered is 3.6 LPA. There are 3-4 batches, with the strength of 20 students each. Triburg, Rina Dhaka, Super Overseas Pvt., Ltd., and Rich Global are some of the companies that came here recently. Majorly students are placed in industries. Students are satisfied with their placements.
review_content.Infrastructure: Smart classes are available along with good working machines and a portal of their own. Workshops are really frequent and helpful. No canteen or hostels are available, and neither are libraries. Labs for all modules are made along with a reception. Furniture is pretty good and comfortable.

reviews_list.batch_info: Diploma in Fashion Design - Batch of 2022
reviews_list.review_title: There are the best faculty members, affordable courses and the best infrastructure.

review_content.Placements: JD has a 99% placements record. There are top recruiters like H&M, Pantaloons, Dharma Productions, CK and many other reputed companies. At the end of every course, JD provides internship opportunities so that students can be prepared for further work. Our college also conducts industry visits, which help students to understand the know-how of industries.
review_content.Infrastructure: JD has the finest infrastructure. Our college provides a conducive environment for the overall growth of students. It provides free Wi-Fi, which is very important in this digital world. There are well-equipped labs, updated machines and a full-fledged library, which has numerous books and smart classrooms. The campus is easily accessible. I find the metro is the best way to reach there.

reviews_list.batch_info: Undergraduate Diploma in Fashion Design - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely satisfied because of faculty, study climate and everything.

review_content.Placements: I am currently in my first year, so I don't know personally, but according to seniors, placements are very high and good. There is also 100% placement in big companies like Zara. Roles offered are designer, stylist, etc. I really like the vibe there, everyone is so friendly.
review_content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, labs, and classrooms, everything is good. There is no campus, it’s more like a building. But classrooms are very good, clean, and hygienic. They are very well maintained. Wi-Fi facility always works well. There are lots of events for sports, games, etc.

paragraphs: Odisha University of Technology and Research, Bhubaneswar admissionincludes several s, such as checking eligibility criteria, application, selection, counselling, document verification, and admission confirmation. Formerly known asCET Bhubneswar, the university admits students on an entrance basis. The application process of the university mainly commences online. Interested students can follow the steps to complete theOUTR admission process:
1 - Check Eligibility

The first requires students to check the course-specific admission criteria. The eligibility requires students to complete the qualifying exam with the specified aggregate and subjects. A general admission criteria for some of the top courses of the university are mentioned in the section above.
2 - Entrance Exam
Students can appear for the test that is prescribed for the particular course such as JEE Main, NATA, CUET PG, etc.
3 - Application & Counselling
Once the exam results are out, students need to participate in state-level counselling (OJEE Counselling). At the time of choice filling, students need to select OUTR as the desired university.
4 - Seat Allocation & Document Verification
When a seat is offered, students need to provide the required documents and report to the university for document verification.
5 - Fee Payment for Admission Confirmation
Selected students need to pay theOUTR admission feesto secure their spots at the university.

OUTR course feesare inclusive of several components, such as tuition fees, library fees, laboratory fees, and more. Some of these components are charged only once by the university, while the remaining are to be paid either yearly or semester-wise as per the guidelines issued by theuniversity. The mode of payment is online and can be paid via UPI/ Credit Card/ Debit Card, etc, at the OUTR fee payment portal. The university's fee ranges between 78 K and 3.2 L, depending on the course and specialisation. Further, when talking about affordability, the courses are relatively affordable when compared to other top universities.
