reviews.review_heading: Good hospitality and a good surrounding college.
reviews.review_text: Our hostel facility is very good, and the quality of the food is also good. Our college authority provides good classrooms, a well-stocked library, and 24/7 high-speed Wi-Fi to all departments. In our college, various labs are available for research. Medical facilities are also available.

reviews.review_heading: Average placement in 2024.
reviews.review_text: My department is supported by good academic facilities and infrastructure. The classrooms are in good condition. High-speed Wi-Fi is available across the department and campus, but some areas experience low speed. The central library provides access to textbooks, reference books, journals, and digital resources. The existing hostel facilities are decent and provide a comfortable living environment with regular water and electricity supply, cleanliness, and basic security. To further improve acco...

reviews.review_heading: This engineering college is much better than other colleges in Odisha.
reviews.review_text: Our course is a self-sustainable course. The branch is the best branch of our college, as it takes the highest JEE percentile score. The labs are good, and all computers are working properly. The classrooms are good, but some of the classrooms are not attached to AC. Our hostel is much better, and the mess food is good, but the price is high. There is a separate floor for each year's students.

reviews.review_heading: A solid government college for Architecture with great exposure and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Architecture department has its own dedicated block. The best part is the spacious and well-lit design studios, which are essential for our work. The department also has its own library with a decent collection of architecture books and journals, though some are a bit dated. The central library is, of course, huge. Hostel facilities are good for the price. The rooms are standard, and Wi-Fi is available, though it can be slow at times. Mess food is average, like any government hostel, but it is h...

reviews.review_heading: Genuine experience after joining Odisha University of Technology and Research.
reviews.review_text: You can't say university has a good infrastructure because it's still a developing campus, as some of the buildings are under construction and will be completed within a year. Wi-Fi is installed all over the academic building but its range does not cover all the places in each building. In campus hostel, you will get a very bad internet speed of Wi-Fi along with your personal internet as there is heavy traffic and no telecom tower near university. You will get a much more options in games as man...

reviews.review_heading: This is a government college.
reviews.review_text: Hostel rooms have 2 (APJ boys hostel) or 3 (RHR boys hostel) beds per room with 1 ceiling fan and 1 tubelight. Meal menu is versatile with good quality tasty food in hostel. Students can play badminton and basketball in respective courts and cricket on grounds. Academic environment and overall environment is quite silent to have self-study. Classrooms are good. Labs are spacious and have all apparatus.

reviews.review_heading: The university for students who dare.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good, but the hostel facilities can be better for the students willing to stay in the hostel. It has a separate hostel for freshers so they can be away from the seniors. There is no ragging. It has sufficient rooms and provides free Wi-Fi.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements this year.
reviews.review_text: Decent campus of 100 acres. Don't expect a good college life, but the canteen food tastes good. The hostel and classrooms are decent. Some smart rooms have AC, and food quality is also 7 out of 10. Clubs, fests, and cultural activities exist, but sometimes feel limited in scale. Some students feel there should be more student engagement outside academics. Industrial exposure (site visits, real-world projects) in core branches seems less consistent.

reviews.review_heading: This university is very good and provides full of knowledge, I recommend to take seat here.
reviews.review_text: The facility and infrastructure at OUTR are very good and well-maintained. All labs are well-equipped and clean, and classrooms are also well-maintained. The hostels have a good Wi-Fi facility, a good mess, and 24/7 medical facilities. The mess food is also very good.

reviews.review_heading: OUTR Bhubaneswar: A growing tech hub with strong placements, evolving infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: OUTR spans over 100 acres with departmental blocks, labs, canteens, sports courts, still expanding, classrooms, and basic facilities. Wi-Fi is spotty. Hostels offer beds, wardrobes, purifiers, a TV in the mess, and decent mess food, but capacity is limited, allotted by rank. Some buildings need renovation, but new construction is underway.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Odisha University of Technology and Research.
reviews.review_text: The department offers Wi-Fi, well-equipped labs, spacious classrooms, and a resourceful library. Hostel facilities are decent, with clean rooms, average food quality in the mess and food street, basic medical facilities, and ample sports and recreational options.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Odisha University of Technology and Research.
reviews.review_text: Facilities available in our hostel included Wi-Fi, drinking water, light, fans, and beds. Fully air-conditioned classrooms were available in our college. A central library was available on our campus, and books could be issued to students. The quality of food in the mess was average. There were three canteens on our campus. The fast food was good. We had a small ground to play different sports like volleyball, football, and cricket.

reviews.review_heading: College of Engineering and Technology Review.
reviews.review_text: The college lacks proper instructors. The classrooms were very basic, and the canteen served only limited items like samosas and tea. Essentially, the college functions more as a place to write exams rather than attend classes. Medical facilities were absent. Hostel facilities were not up to that mark, but they ensured comfort for students. The mess serves hygienic food, and the water supply was well managed.

reviews.review_heading: It is a decent college with a high return.
reviews.review_text: Above-average facilities are available here. The quality of food is very good. Sport facilities are average. Mess and canteen quality is good, but not excellent. Medical facilities are very good. Our college owns a personal ambulance for emergencies. The library is excellent in our college. From the 2nd year, classrooms are attached to AC. But in 1st year, there is no AC.

reviews.review_heading: Odisha University of Technology and Research review.
reviews.review_text: College campus features academic buildings, research centers, a central library, well-equipped labs and classrooms, and also has Wi-Fi access. Students have access to residential facilities and dining halls. The hostel facilities at the college are generally considered decent. The quality of food in the mess is average. Basic medical facilities are available, including an on-campus health center.

faqs.answer: A:    CDLU follows a seat reservation policy as per the guidelines of Haryana government. The reservation policy is as follows:15% of the seats shall be open/unreserved and will be filled through All India Quota (AIQ) (including Haryana). Out of the 15%  AIQ seats,  10% will be reserved for Economically Weaker Section (EWS)Remaining 85% seats are reserved for bona fide residents of Haryana (State Quota) and will be filled up asdetailed below:i) Haryana Open General Open Category (HOGC) - 40% of the State Quotaii) Reserved category of Haryana - 60% of the State Quotaiii) Scheduled Caste (SC) - 20% of State quotaiv) Backward Classes of Haryana (A) (BCA) - 16% of State quotav) Backward Classes of Haryana (B) (BCB) - 11% of State quotavi) Economically Weaker Section (EWS) - 10% of State quotavii) Differently Abled Persons / Divyang - 3% of State quota

faqs.answer: A:    Chaudhary Devi Lal University (CDLU) offers MBA programs through three entrance exams: CAT (Common Admission Test), CMAT (Common Management Aptitude Test), UET (University Entrance Test), and GMAT (Graduate Management Admission Test). The CAT is the most widely accepted entrance exam for MBA programs in India, with minimum cut-offs varying depending on the programme and specialization. CMAT is another national-level MBA entrance exam accepted by several universities, with minimum cut-offs varying for specific programs. CDLU conducts its own UET for certain MBA programs and specializations, with minimum UET score cut-offs determined by CDLU for each programme and specialization. GMAT scores may be considered alongside other entrance exam scores or during the selection process. Other factors like academic merit and work experience can also influence the selection process. For detailed information on acceptable entrance exams, minimum score cut-offs, and admission criteria, visit the CDLU website's Admission page or individual programme brochures. It is important to consult the latest official information from CDLU to stay updated on the admission process for your desired program.

review_content.Placements: I was a student at one of the colleges in CDLU, Sirsa. It is a government college. There was a separate placement cell that organized placement from time to time. faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for B.Des at SAP Sharda University?
faqs.answer: Hey buddy,You can take admission in SAP Sharda University by appearing in SUAT examination conducted by the University.But you should have Mathematics as a compulsory subject in your 12th.Also you must have 50% marks in your 12th.There is one more eligibility criteria of this university for it's B.Tech and B.Des programme that you should have physics and a subject in your 12th but it depends on the programme you are pursuing.Hope this will help.

admission_overview.college_name: SAM Global University Admission 2025: Eligibility, Fee, Application, Scholarships

paragraphs: SAM Global University admission is open for all the courses. The university offers UG, PG, diploma and doctoral programmes specialised in Engineering, Commerce, Business administration and others.SAM Global Universityconducted an online mode of application. Admission to all the courses is both merit and entrance-based. Applicants looking for admission to the university can apply online through the official website of SAM Global University. To know more about the SAM Global University admission process along with course eligibility and selection criteria go through the below segments:

SAM Global University offers entrance and merit-based admission to all its courses. Admission to all UG, PG, diploma and PhD courses is open. Candidates who meet the minimum eligibility criteria for the respective course must appear for the entrance exam for admission to BTech, MTech, MBA, BAMS and other courses. The table below lists SAM Global University courses eligibility along with their accepted entrance exams, & selection process:
BTech with 60% aggregate (55% aggregate for reserved category)
MAT,CAT,XAT, GMAT
Class 10 and Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology/Mathematics as core subjects with 50% aggregate from a recognised board
Check here for detailed eligibility criteria for moreSAM Global University courses

SAM Global University admission process includes registration, online application online counselling and reporting admission confirmation. Candidates must follow the below steps to get a seat at SAM Global University:
STEP 1: SAM Global University Pune Application Process 2025
Candidates are required to apply online on the official website of the college. Candidates need to pay an application fee to complete the application procedure.
STEP 2: Selection Rounds

SAM Global University Pune shortlists candidates based on national-level entrance exams such as JEE Main/GATE/MAT and CAT as per respective courses. The college will display a provisional merit list. Candidates will be called for online counselling (merit-based seat allotment) and reporting. Further, for some courses university offers direct admission based on the last-qualifying exam score.
STEP 3: Merit List andAdmission Confirmation
Once selection rounds are over, the college releases a merit list. To allow and confirm the seat candidates are required to pay theSAM Global University course fee.

reviews.review_heading: The best colleges in NCR. If you want the best infrastructure, this college is very good for you.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the college is very nice, like a dream college. They have aesthetic views and provide nice facilities to their students. They have an AC classroom, nice branches, brand corners for the cafeteria. Along with an advanced library, and a big auditorium for students.

reviews.review_heading: College is very good, the campus is quite big, and the faculty are supportive.
reviews.review_text: Hostel is quite big, good and clean, and cold water is available, and rooms have wardrobes and beds of good quality. Also, the electricity is available all the time. Warden is also very supportive.

reviews.review_heading: Very satisfied, it gives us good placement, infrastructure, and the faculty is good.
reviews.review_text: Everything is good, whether it is infrastructure, classroom, hostel room, Wi-Fi, or lab everything is good, the quality of hostel rooms is very good, they are spacious and always clean. Food is good, medical facilities are good, and all sports games are played both in the college campus and outside the campus for competitions..

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides all types of support to the students.
reviews.review_text: We do have a lab with proper managing staff and a lab attendant. We do have smart boards in our classes and a separate departmental library in our pharmacy department. The hostels are in very good condition, and the wardens of both hostels are very supportive and treat all the students as their own children.

reviews.review_heading: Our college Infrastructure and water facilities are good.
reviews.review_text: Labs are well-equipped, neat, and have good facilities. Infrastructure is also good, clean, and full of ventilation with A.C., fans, and windows. A digital library is also available for some books. Wi-Fi is available in each department and hostel for students and teachers.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with this college because of good faculty, placement, and really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Lingaya’s Vidyapeeth is a very good college, and the facilities and infrastructure of the college are very good. The college contains various departments like Pharmacy, Law, Nursing, etc. The classes are also very good, the labs are smart, and the library is very good.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is very time-restricted, students are not allowed to go outside the college before 3 pm.
reviews.review_text: Labs are well-equipped, neat, and have good facilities. Infrastructure is also good, clean, and full of ventilation with AC, fans, and windows. A digital library is also available but only for some books. Wi-Fi is available in the hostel for students. Games and sports encourage students towards competition.

reviews.review_heading: I am happy to have gotten admission in Lingaya’s Vidyapeeth.
reviews.review_text: Our B.Pharma department has fully equipped labs, smart classrooms, high-speed Wi-Fi, and a rich library, hostel facilities are clean, with good food in the mess and canteen. Medical support, sports, and games are well-maintained and easily accessible. I am very happy.

reviews.review_heading: Lingaya's Vidyapeeth review.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure for both the college and the hostel is living worthy. Cleaning is done according to the timetable regularly by the cleaning staff. A little development at some what part may be needed, but overall, the building, rooms, classes, and whole infrastructure are above average.

reviews.review_heading: College is great. The faculty are nice.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and facilities are nice and good. Labs are always available for students. Labs are in good condition, and all the instruments, chemicals and glassware are available for students. Chemicals are of good quality and condition, and the instruments are of good quality.

reviews.review_heading: Good college for all the students.
reviews.review_text:
Wi-Fi is not available. State scholarship is not available in this college. 
Labs are good. Classroom is not very good. No AC in any classroom, 
if there is any, they will not be working. Teachers are very supportive and helpful, especially the sports teacher. The ground is very good. Academic activity is regularly done. Good senior behaviour.

reviews.review_heading: Best college in Faridabad.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure of the college and each department of education are the best at their level, as they are properly ventilated and built. The facilities in the hostel and mess are also nice, and the quality of food served in the canteen is also good.

reviews.review_heading: The best college I found for my higher studies.
reviews.review_text: The first thing I loved in my college was the infrastructure. The buildings and the green around the college are so good. Infrastructure is so amazing, I love my college, it was so good I can see my future bright. A blessed teacher, the best mentor to support.

reviews.review_heading: College is an okay environment, okay crowd. Here, it's not good, but the facility is nice.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not so good. There are no ACs in the classroom. The lab seating arrangement is not good. The class is so crowded that I wanted to change the seating arrangement, and also the classroom cleanliness. The seats are so comfortable, and kindly look into this problem, there is no Wi-Fi in the classroom or lab.

reviews.review_heading: It's good for only the pharmacy in Faridabad under a good budget, but not for other courses.
reviews.review_text: Very old buildings and bad flooring, ceiling and wall materials. Titles are getting broken at many places in college. Also, a few water coolers are working, others are in the worst condition. AC doesn't work either, only in the Offices of the facility. Don't get fooled by AC at exception.
